name: kiso-plugins
title_zh: 七件一套的 Claude Code 技能包，装完即用
tagline_zh: 一个个去搜去挑技能太累，这包七个已经配好、彼此不打架，clone 下来放进目录就能用，省掉一晚上的筛选和试错。
tagline_en: Stop hunting skills one by one. Seven pre-matched, non-conflicting skills you clone into place and use tonight.
why_zh: 七个技能是一起调过的，命名和触发边界互不重叠，不会出现两个技能抢同一句话的情况。
why_en: All seven were tuned together: names and trigger boundaries don't overlap, so two skills never fight over the same prompt.
limit_zh: 只覆盖这七个技能各自的场景，包内不含安装脚本和依赖检查；你的项目若需要别的能力，得自己另找，它不会替你补。
limit_en: Covers only these seven skills' scenarios; no installer or dependency check. Other needs you source yourself.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A 7-skill pack for Claude Code, install and go
